name: Salata Falahiyeh (Palestinian or Farmers Salad)

ingredients.name: scant tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, cucumbers, onion, chile (if using), and lemon (if using). Stir in mint, olive oil, and lemon juice until thoroughly combined. Season with salt and serve right away.

schema_metadata.keywords: Salata Falahiyeh, Palestinian salad, farmers salad, tomato salad, cucumber salad, salata, salata na’ameh, chopped salad, israeli salad, salat aravi

description: If all you have at home are tomatoes, onion, and mint, you can enjoy a very delicious salad.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 fresh green chile pepper, such as jalapeño or Anaheim (optional), stemmed, seeded, and finely minced; 1/2 unwaxed lemon, ends trimmed and seeds discarded, and rind, pith, and flesh minced (optional)

Optional substitutions: yellow onion → 4 medium scallions; finely chopped fresh mint leaves → 2 tsp crushed dried mint

Notes: If making this salad out of season, opt for cherry or plum tomatoes.
author: Reem Kassis
